evaluator_expectations: Quality and pertinence of the project's research and innovation objectives (and the extent to which they are ambitious, and go beyond the state of the art) [OPTION for MSCA Doctoral networks, Postdoctoral fellowships]

Soundness of the proposed methodology (including interdisciplinary approaches, consideration of the gender dimension and other diversity aspects if relevant for the research project, and the quality and appropriateness of open science practices)
Quality of the supervision, training and of the two-way transfer of knowledge between the researcher and the host [OPTION for MSCA Postdoctoral fellowships]
Quality and appropriateness of the researcher's professional experience, competences and skills
Credibility of the measures to enhance the career perspectives and employability of the researcher and contribution to his/her skills development [OPTION for MSCA Postdoctoral fellowships]

Suitability and quality of the measures to maximise expected outcomes and impacts, as set out in the dissemination and exploitation plan, including communication activities [OPTION for all MSCA except Special needs allowances and COFUND Choose Europe]
The magnitude and importance of the project's contribution to the expected scientific, societal and economic impacts [OPTION for MSCA Doctoral networks, Postdoctoral fellowships and Staff exchanges]

criteria.criterion_name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation
evaluator_expectations: Quality and effectiveness of the work plan, assessment of risks and appropriateness of the effort assigned to work packages [OPTION for all MSCA except Special needs allowances and COFUND Choose Europe]
Quality and capacity of the host institutions and participating organisations, including hosting arrangements [OPTION for MSCA Postdoctoral fellowships]

Quality and capacity of the recruiting institutions, including hosting arrangements and institutional procedures' alignment with the European Charter for Researchers (institutions with the HRS4R label are exempted from providing further justification for this criterion) and the Agreement on Reforming Research Assessment
